name: Blace
source:
Mysterious twin of Jace who appeared as a transfer student. He is in the same class as the heroine. His whole body is bandaged for unknown reason. Blace is usually moody. He does not like to reveal anything from his background.

[From [url=https://darknights-time.weebly.com/blace-and-jace.html]official website[/url]]
